method: World-frame static wrench recursion J7 to J1, independently checked by direct summation and finite-difference potential-energy derivative. SI internally.
limits: Static gravity only. No speed, acceleration, reflected rotor inertia, friction, cable torque, shock or contact process forces.
All wrench moments are reported at the kinematic joint origin, not at a confirmed physical bearing or flange plane.
Motor centre-of-mass and output mass split remain unverified.
Only existing A05 proxy collision pairs are screened; no continuous collision or cable sweep proof.
Catalogue rated torque is a comparator, not the enclosed arm's continuous zero-speed holding capacity.
Structure allowance and head mass are scenarios, not revised requirements or selected manufactured masses.
sensitivity_scope: Mass sensitivity and payload COM cases are at reference pose only; sample maxima apply only to reference_scenario.

head_eccentricity_bound.note: Triangle-inequality bound over gravity orientation. Not a measured head COM. Nominal whole-arm scan assumes centred COM.

sampled_gravity.note: Finite sample maxima, not global maxima or certified safe workspace; separate joints reach maxima at different poses.
